Method of Attack: Ransomware that identifies when running on computers with PLC software, locks the device, and alters PLC parameters under the hood
Alters programmable logic controller (PLC) parameters to disrupt industrial control systems
Discoverer: Researchers from the Georgia Institute of Technology (GIT)
Raheem Beyah, associate chair in the Georgia Tech School of Electrical and Computer Engineering
David Formby, a Georgia Tech Ph.D. student
Impacted Systems: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) networks
Attack Vector: Infection of critical networks controlling PLCs, such as water treatment facility networks
Exploitation of weak points in company firewalls or hacked users leading to total network compromise
